name: Can I evict a tenant just to sell my property?

mainEntity.name: Can I evict a tenant just to sell my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, you cannot evict a tenant solely for the purpose of selling a property, especially if they have a valid lease agreement in place. Eviction typically requires specific grounds such as non-payment of rent, lease violations, or the expiration of a lease that is not being renewed. Attempting a no-fault eviction can lead to legal complications and delays. It's essential to consult with a real estate professional like Kelby Contreras to understand your options and ensure any actions comply with Florida landlord-tenant laws.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, you generally cannot evict a tenant just to sell if they have a valid lease. Eviction requires specific legal grounds.
